description: Django/Wagtail application generated from the reusable Wagtail project template.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key ID used by the application to write to S3.

AWS_S3_REGION_NAME.description: AWS region containing the S3 bucket.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret access key used by the application to write to S3.

AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME.description: S3 bucket used for production static and media files.

SITE_URL.description: Canonical public site URL, including https:// and no trailing slash.
